propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(repo, 'list') to establish fixture preconditions, relying on incidental side effects of a best-effort read path that silently fails under CI load, causing misleading setup failures.

8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions where the sync must land for the test to be meaningful; these should use the deterministic _sync_from_origin helper (checked fetch + ff-only merge) instead of relying on side effects.

15 of the 23 sites are testing read-side reconvergence behavior where the production read path sync IS the property under test, and converting them to raw git would delete the invariant they exist to prove.
The _sync_from_origin helper must be moved from line 1680 to the helper block near line 76 so it is defined before all use sites and documented with the Kind-P/Kind-R classification rule.
A third category of 18 raw git push legs with check=True exist separately from the 23 read-sync pairs and are not addressed by the audit scope.
